Tennis players limit media at Wimbledon over prize money dispute

Top tennis players are reducing their media interactions at Wimbledon to protest prize money distribution. The dispute centers on the players' assertion that prize money constitutes a small percentage of tournament revenue, a concern first raised at the French Open. This action highlights ongoing tensions between players and tournament organizers regarding financial compensation.
